name: config.http_adapter
message: Removed in 5.0 with the faraday removal; use config.transport.transport_class with a custom transport class if you need another HTTP client.

name: config.faraday_builder
message: Removed in 5.0 with the faraday removal; use config.transport.transport_class with a custom transport class instead.

name: config.async
message: Removed in 6.0.0 as a deprecated option; delete the line.

name: config.logger
message: Removed in 6.0.0 (the old config.logger= setter); use config.sdk_logger= instead.

name: config.metrics
message: Removed in 6.0.0 together with Sentry::Metrics and all metrics code; delete the option.

name: monotonic_active_support_logger
message: Removed in 6.0.0 as a config.breadcrumbs_logger value; remove it from the list.

name: config.enabled_environments
message: Default changed in 6.0.0 from [] to nil (send to all environments); set it explicitly if you relied on the old default.

name: enable_logs
message: Removed in 7.0.0 because logs are now on by default; delete the option.

name: enable_metrics
message: Removed in 7.0.0 because metrics are now on by default; delete the option.

name: send_default_pii
message: Deprecated in 7.0.0 (still defaults to false); migrate to config.data_collection (user_info, http_bodies and related keys).

name: trace_ignore_status_codes
message: Default changed in 7.1.0: 302 and 303 are no longer in the default ignore list, so set trace_ignore_status_codes explicitly if you need them excluded.

name: config.rails.structured_logging.enabled
message: Default changed in 7.1.0: Rails structured logging is off unless you set config.rails.structured_logging.enabled = true.
